_comment: Optional. Copy this file to data/roster.json and fill in real names/roles to override how people appear on the dashboard. Key by the person's Jira display name (exactly as it appears in Jira) or their Jira accountId. Add `slackId` (their Slack member ID, e.g. from their Slack profile > More > Copy member ID) so Slack-sourced signals attach to the same person instead of creating a separate entry.
